messages:
alex: Hey folks 1 PR #2750 is up: 'Private config examples & migration notes' (adds a brief appendix and two SDK snippet variants). Preview: https://preview.redwood-inference.com/pr-2750. Assigning @meera for tech check and @ben for copy/style. Heads up: preview failed linkcheck + vale + spellcheck so hold on merging.

ci-bot: CI summary for PR #2750 1 failing checks: linkcheck, vale, spellcheck. To re-run checks comment '/retest'.

alex: Pasting the failing output to make triage easier:
```
LINKCHECK FAIL: /docs/private/config-examples.md -> broken link: https://partners.example.com/private-setup (404)
VALE FAIL: docs/private/config-examples.md:63  VALE[Clarity] sentence flagged: 'The setup can be done by following the steps described below which ensure appropriate network isolation is achieved.'
SPELLCHECK WARNING: 'onprem' might be 'on-prem' or 'on premise' (docs/private/config-examples.md:22)
```

meera: I'll take the partner link. They moved their page; rather than link externally, I'll add a short inline KB snippet and reference our canonical KB: https://kb.redwood-inference.com/private/networking. That avoids external 404s.

ben: I'll rephrase the flagged sentence to be more direct and remove passive voice. Also will change 'onprem' -> 'on-prem' and run Vale locally to catch other rules.

alex: Quick Qs: 1) If you push fixes will preview rebuild automatically? 2) This touches SDK snippets that are pinned downstream can we avoid reformatting them?

docs-bot: Pull request updated  new commit 4d8a2f1 pushed by meera. Docs preview rebuild queued: https://preview.redwood-inference.com/pr-2750

meera: I kept the SDK snippets byte-identical (no whitespace/quote changes) and added a tiny inline networking snippet in the appendix. Commit note: replaced external partner link with KB path.

ci-bot: Docs preview completed  linkcheck PASS, spellcheck PASS, vale FAIL (1 rule).

ben: The remaining Vale flag is a Clarity rule on sentence at line 63. I shortened it to: 'Follow these steps to configure network isolation for Private deployments.' Pushing that now.

docs-bot: Pull request updated  new commit 9f7b3c4 pushed by ben. Preview rebuild queued: https://preview.redwood-inference.com/pr-2750

ci-bot: Docs preview passed  all checks green.

alex: All green  thanks. Plan to merge in the docs merge window at 10:45 PT unless anyone objects. Note: PR description updated with KB cross-ref and a short note about keeping SDK snippet formatting for downstream pins.

sam: LGTM  please include an explicit note in the PR body with the exact lines of the snippet that were pinned so infra-integrations can verify quickly.

meera: Done  added the pinned-lines section to the PR description and pinged infra-integrations.

ben: Style/tech LGTM. No functional changes to snippets.

alex: Thanks all. I'll squash-merge at 10:45 PT if nothing pops up. :thumbsup:

docs-bot: PR #2750 merged by alex (squash). Change summary: docs(private): add config examples appendix and migration notes; replace external partner link with KB; keep SDK snippet formatting to preserve pins. KB: https://kb.redwood-inference.com/private/networking

sam: Noted  will follow up with infra-integrations. End thread.
